description: Curated literature graph. Only cites edges assert a verified citation. Other paper links are explicitly typed reading relationships or hypotheses; author/topic edges derive from metadata and task classification.

nodes.label: Operator universality
nodes.title: Universal approximation to nonlinear operators by neural networks with arbitrary activation functions and its application to dynamical systems
nodes.summary: Early neural-network approximation theorem for nonlinear operators.
nodes.limits: An existence result, not a guarantee of efficient training or recovery from arbitrary sparse observations.
nodes.publication_status: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks 6(4):911–917; DOI 10.1109/72.392253

nodes.label: Empirical interpolation
nodes.title: An empirical interpolation method: application to efficient reduced-basis discretization of partial differential equations
nodes.summary: Builds a reduced representation of parameter-dependent functions using selected evaluation points.
nodes.limits: Historical foundation for avoiding expensive full-domain evaluations. Its original target is reduced-basis PDE computation, not training a neural operator.
nodes.publication_status: Comptes Rendus Mathematique 339 (2004), 667–672; DOI 10.1016/j.crma.2004.08.006

nodes.label: DEIM
nodes.title: Discrete Empirical Interpolation for Nonlinear Model Reduction
nodes.summary: Uses a reduced basis and selected entries to cheaply approximate nonlinear terms.
nodes.limits: A key baseline for sample-efficient evaluation. The original technical-report URL was inaccessible; bibliography verified through the author page and SIAM article, without claiming full-text review.
nodes.publication_status: Rice technical report TR09-05 (2009); precursor to SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 2010 DEIM article

nodes.label: Stable compressed sensing
nodes.title: Stable Signal Recovery from Incomplete and Inaccurate Measurements
nodes.summary: Establishes stable sparse-signal recovery from incomplete noisy linear measurements under conditions on the measurement matrix.
nodes.limits: Explains why sparsity alone is insufficient: the measurement process must expose the sparse representation. A foundation, not a universal neural-network speedup theorem.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Sparse operator identification
nodes.title: Identification of Sparse Linear Operators
nodes.summary: Identifies structured linear operators from probing signals under conditions on their spreading-function support.
nodes.limits: Direct predecessor for learning the operator itself through sparse recovery. The specific time-frequency operator class matters; its guarantees do not cover arbitrary temperature-conditioned kernels.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: SINDy
nodes.title: Discovering governing equations from data: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamical systems
nodes.summary: Fits sparse combinations of candidate nonlinear functions to discover dynamical equations from data.
nodes.limits: Useful sparse-regression comparator. Learning an evolution equation differs from learning a finite-horizon solution operator; derivative estimation and the dictionary are consequential.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Sparse polynomial approximation
nodes.title: Compressed sensing approaches for polynomial approximation of high-dimensional functions
nodes.summary: Reviews structured sparse polynomial approximation and weighted recovery for high-dimensional functions.
nodes.limits: Seed paper. Its sparsity and regularity assumptions motivate faster kernel identification; they do not establish that an arbitrary learned integrand has a sparse expansion.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Generative compressed sensing
nodes.title: Compressed Sensing using Generative Models
nodes.summary: Uses the range of a generative model as a prior for recovering signals from limited measurements.
nodes.limits: Connects learned structure to recovery guarantees. This concerns recovering a signal using a learned prior, not automatically accelerating training of that prior.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Empirical cubature
nodes.title: Dimensional hyper-reduction of nonlinear finite element models via empirical cubature
nodes.summary: Selects integration points and positive weights to reproduce reduced internal-force integrals in finite-element models.
nodes.limits: Closest classical baseline for the proposed inference acceleration. A quadrature rule fitted to snapshots must be checked on unseen fields and operating regimes.
nodes.publication_status: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 313 (2017), 687–722

nodes.label: World Models
nodes.title: World Models
nodes.summary: Learns a compact predictive environment model and trains a controller using that representation.
nodes.limits: Historical bridge to learned simulation for control. A latent recurrent world model is not a discretization-convergent neural operator.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: DeepONet
nodes.title: DeepONet: Learning nonlinear operators for identifying differential equations based on the universal approximation theorem of operators
nodes.summary: Represents an operator using an input-function encoder and a coordinate-dependent output representation.
nodes.limits: Core architecture and reference for sensor-to-field prediction. The original fixed-sensor branch network does not automatically support arbitrary input sensor layouts.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Graph Kernel Network
nodes.title: Neural Operator: Graph Kernel Network for Partial Differential Equations
nodes.summary: Learns kernel interactions over spatial samples to approximate PDE solution maps.
nodes.limits: Direct ancestor of integral neural operators and a useful connection to graph methods; graph sampling and numerical integration still affect the result.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Fourier Neural Operator
nodes.title: Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations
nodes.summary: Learns global interactions through spectral transformations for families of PDE problems.
nodes.limits: Essential architectural baseline. Keeping trained parameters across grids does not remove aliasing, spectral truncation, or discretization error.
nodes.publication_status: ICLR 2021; cited as such in the 2026 seed

nodes.label: Graph Network Simulator
nodes.title: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
nodes.summary: Learns particle-based physical simulation across materials using graph-network interactions.
nodes.limits: Important adjacent physical-world-model baseline for deformable objects and fluids. Do not label every graph simulator as a neural operator in the stronger function-space sense.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Neural operator foundations
nodes.title: Neural Operator: Learning Maps Between Function Spaces
nodes.summary: Develops a function-space framework, approximation theory, and several efficient operator parameterizations.
nodes.limits: Seed paper; read its low-rank and multipole constructions when considering acceleration. Formal expressivity results are distinct from sample efficiency and optimization success.

nodes.label: U-FNO / CO2 storage
nodes.title: U-FNO -- An enhanced Fourier neural operator-based deep-learning model for multiphase flow
nodes.summary: Combines U-Net-style processing with Fourier operator components for multiphase subsurface flow.
nodes.limits: A concrete industrially relevant application: pressure and saturation fields during CO2 injection. Validation is for the modeled parameter family, not unrestricted reservoir transfer.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Seismic operators
nodes.title: Seismic wave propagation and inversion with Neural Operators
nodes.summary: Studies neural-operator surrogates for wave propagation and seismic inversion.
nodes.limits: Shows how fast forward models can support inverse tasks. An inaccurate surrogate can bias inversion even when average forward error looks small.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: FourCastNet
nodes.title: FourCastNet: A Global Data-driven High-resolution Weather Model using Adaptive Fourier Neural Operators
nodes.summary: Uses adaptive Fourier neural operators for global weather prediction and inexpensive ensembles.
nodes.limits: Seed paper. Forecast inference speed is not training speed or complete operational-system speed; reanalysis data are not raw sparse sensor inputs.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: PDEBench
nodes.title: PDEBENCH: An Extensive Benchmark for Scientific Machine Learning
nodes.summary: Provides multiple PDE datasets and baseline implementations for scientific machine learning.
nodes.limits: Good controlled starting point for quadrature and operator comparisons. A selected subset is enough; simulation performance does not establish industrial readiness.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Neural Inverse Operators
nodes.title: Neural Inverse Operators for Solving PDE Inverse Problems
nodes.summary: Combines operator-learning components for PDE inverse problems where observations encode an operator-valued measurement map.
nodes.limits: A direct inverse-problem connection. This formulation is more specific than treating every sparse-observation problem as the same inverse operator.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Electromagnetic inverse design
nodes.title: A neural operator-based surrogate solver for free-form electromagnetic inverse design
nodes.summary: Uses a neural-operator surrogate for repeated electromagnetic evaluation during inverse design.
nodes.limits: Illustrates the many-query business case. Final designs should be checked using the original physical solver, since an optimizer may exploit surrogate error.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Spherical FNO
nodes.title: Spherical Fourier Neural Operators: Learning Stable Dynamics on the Sphere
nodes.summary: Adapts spectral operator computation to spherical geometry for atmospheric dynamics.
nodes.limits: A clear development after FourCastNet: geometry and rollout behavior matter. Long stable trajectories do not imply accurate day-by-day long-range weather forecasts.
nodes.publication_status: ICML 2023; PMLR 202

nodes.label: PDE backstepping control
nodes.title: Neural Operators for PDE Backstepping Control of First-Order Hyperbolic PIDE with Recycle and Delay
nodes.summary: Approximates a controller-design operator with DeepONet for a hyperbolic system with recycle and delay.
nodes.limits: A genuine operator-learning/control connection. Controller-kernel approximation differs from learning an unconstrained robot world model, and stability arguments depend on the stated system assumptions.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: GINO / car aerodynamics
nodes.title: Geometry-Informed Neural Operator for Large-Scale 3D PDEs
nodes.summary: Combines graph-based geometry handling with a regular latent Fourier grid for 3D aerodynamic prediction.
nodes.limits: Strong example beyond weather and a baseline for irregular geometry. Geometry transfer is tested over a dataset family, not guaranteed across arbitrary equipment.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Continuous empirical cubature
nodes.title: CECM: A continuous empirical cubature method with application to the dimensional hyperreduction of parameterized finite element models
nodes.summary: Optimizes integration locations as well as weights to obtain small positive cubature rules.
nodes.limits: Very close to smart-point selection. It assumes evaluations at movable points are available; fixed physical sensors impose a different feasible set.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: DreamerV3
nodes.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
nodes.summary: Learns latent dynamics and improves an actor through imagined trajectories across control domains.
nodes.limits: Represents the action-conditioned world-model branch. It is not an FNO; compare control success and rollout robustness, not just reconstruction accuracy.
nodes.publication_status: Collected arXiv precursor; journal article in Nature (2025) has title Mastering diverse control tasks through world models

nodes.label: Optimal sampling / Christoffel
nodes.title: Optimal sampling for least-squares approximation
nodes.summary: Explains weighted least-squares sampling strategies tied to the approximation space through Christoffel functions.
nodes.limits: Important continuation of the sparse-approximation branch. Sampling training examples in a function space must be distinguished from choosing spatial quadrature nodes within one example.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Operator sample complexity
nodes.title: The Sample Complexity of Learning Lipschitz Operators with respect to Gaussian Measures
nodes.summary: Analyzes information limits for learning Lipschitz operators under Gaussian measures, including adaptive linear samples.
nodes.limits: The September 2026 revision changes the title and emphasis relative to older search snippets. Strong structure is needed to beat generic worst-case limits; this is not evidence that every adaptive scheme is ineffective in practice.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Nonlinear model-class sampling
nodes.title: A Unified Framework for Learning with Nonlinear Model Classes from Arbitrary Linear Samples
nodes.summary: Unifies learning from linear samples for nonlinear model classes, including compressed sensing and active regression.
nodes.limits: A mathematical bridge for designing informative measurements. Translating its assumptions into implementable neural-operator sampling rules is additional research.

nodes.label: FNO discretization error
nodes.title: Discretization Error of Fourier Neural Operators
nodes.summary: Analyzes errors introduced when a continuous Fourier neural operator is evaluated on a finite grid.
nodes.limits: Essential for the inference-quadrature thesis: accurately fitting training outputs does not determine how aggressively evaluation grids can be reduced.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Poseidon
nodes.title: Poseidon: Efficient Foundation Models for PDEs
nodes.summary: Pretrains a PDE model and adapts it to downstream physical problems.
nodes.limits: Evidence of movement toward transfer across tasks and physics. Pretraining-scale costs differ sharply from a small thesis experiment using an existing model or benchmark.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Kernel Neural Operators
nodes.title: Kernel Neural Operators (KNOs) for Scalable, Memory-efficient, Geometrically-flexible Operator Learning
nodes.summary: Separates trainable kernel design from quadrature and supports geometrically flexible integral-operator computation.
nodes.limits: One of the closest neural-operator references to the proposed project. The June 2026 revision adds substantial theory and kernel detail; fewer parameters alone do not prove fewer integration evaluations.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: The Well
nodes.title: The Well: a Large-Scale Collection of Diverse Physics Simulations for Machine Learning
nodes.summary: Collects diverse spatiotemporal physical simulations with a common learning interface.
nodes.limits: Useful for evaluating beyond familiar toy PDEs. Dataset size and difficult dynamics require careful subset selection for a master's project.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Planning Neural Operator
nodes.title: Generalizable Motion Planning via Operator Learning
nodes.summary: Learns the map from spatial cost functions to motion-planning value functions, motivated by an Eikonal PDE.
nodes.limits: Direct robotics evidence, including 4-DOF manipulation planning. It predicts a planning quantity rather than action-conditioned physical evolution of manipulated objects.
nodes.publication_status: ICLR 2025; inspected PDF states venue

nodes.label: Neural Fourier Modelling
nodes.title: Neural Fourier Modelling: A Highly Compact Approach to Time-Series Analysis
nodes.summary: Models time series in the frequency domain, including evaluation under changed sampling rates.
nodes.limits: An adjacent signal-modeling baseline for industrial time series. Fourier-domain processing alone does not establish all function-space neural-operator guarantees.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: NeuralOperator library
nodes.title: A Library for Learning Neural Operators
nodes.summary: Provides implementations and training infrastructure for neural operator architectures.
nodes.limits: A practical starting point. Software support and installation should be checked when selecting the eventual experiment, rather than inferred from a paper's model name.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Focused ultrasound / DeepONet
nodes.title: Convolutional Deep Operator Networks for Learning Nonlinear Focused Ultrasound Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Spinal Cord Anatomy
nodes.summary: Predicts acoustic pressure fields for heterogeneous spinal-cord anatomy using a DeepONet surrogate.
nodes.limits: Concrete biomedical application of repeated physical prediction. It uses simulated pressure maps; the paper is not evidence of clinical deployment or therapeutic benefit.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: DeepVIVONet / marine risers
nodes.title: DeepVIVONet: Using deep neural operators to optimize sensor locations with application to vortex-induced vibrations
nodes.summary: Uses marine-riser field data for sparse reconstruction and forecasting, then optimizes sensor placement with an outer loop.
nodes.limits: Closest applied match to industrial sensing. Transfer to different flow conditions involves transfer learning; optimized physical sensors are not the same as cheap post-acquisition quadrature subsampling.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: V-JEPA 2
nodes.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
nodes.summary: Combines video representation learning with action-conditioned post-training for robot planning.
nodes.limits: Concrete manipulation/world-model reference. Robot interaction data are still used; reported zero-shot deployment is not zero robot training. Camera sensitivity and long-horizon errors remain material limitations.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: FourCastNet 3
nodes.title: FourCastNet 3: A geometric approach to probabilistic machine-learning weather forecasting at scale
nodes.summary: Moves toward probabilistic geometric weather forecasting with spherical convolution and efficient ensembles.
nodes.limits: A successor in the weather program, not simply the original AFNO made larger. Realistic long-run spectra and calibration must not be conflated with deterministic forecast skill at the same horizon.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: PINNs with Learnable Quadrature
nodes.title: PINNs with Learnable Quadrature
nodes.summary: Learns quadrature rules for PINN loss evaluation, with a hypernetwork extension across PDE instances.
nodes.limits: Recent relevant prior art. Its main integration target is training-loss evaluation; applying its mechanism to neural-operator inference requires a separate argument and experiment.
nodes.publication_status: NeurIPS 2025

nodes.label: Additive-manufacturing distortion
nodes.title: Real-time distortion prediction in metallic additive manufacturing via a physics-informed neural operator approach
nodes.summary: Combines operator and recurrent components to predict distortion from thermal history, with physics-based training constraints.
nodes.limits: An industrial time-history example. The training/testing data come from an experimentally validated FEM generator, which is weaker evidence than independent end-to-end production deployment.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: FNO practical guide
nodes.title: Fourier Neural Operators Explained: A Practical Perspective
nodes.summary: Explains Fourier neural operators, implementation decisions, and numerical behavior.
nodes.limits: A practical companion to the theoretical seed. Read selected sections rather than reproducing a large architecture without understanding the transforms and discretization.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Soft-robot shape control
nodes.title: Infinite-Dimensional Closed-Loop Inverse Kinematics for Soft Robots via Neural Operators
nodes.summary: Learns a differentiable actuation-to-shape operator and composes it with task maps for inverse kinematics.
nodes.limits: Direct route back to robotics. The inspected demonstrations are analytical/model-based; do not treat them as validated real-hardware generalization or a general-purpose world model.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Operator theory tour
nodes.title: A short tour of operator learning theory: Convergence rates, statistical limits, and open questions
nodes.summary: Summarizes approximation rates and statistical limitations for operator learning.
nodes.limits: A compact recent bridge between the older polynomial paper and modern operator-learning theory. It is a survey, not independent empirical validation of all methods discussed.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: V-JEPA 2.1
nodes.title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
nodes.summary: Develops dense video/image representations through revised predictive objectives and reports downstream visual and robot evaluations.
nodes.limits: Shows the world-model branch moving toward richer spatial features. This does not by itself establish accurate physical simulation or an operator architecture.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Quadrature-aware acoustics
nodes.title: Quadrature-Aware Complex-Linear Neural Operator for Boundary-to-Field Prediction in Resonant Acoustics
nodes.summary: Uses a complex-linear, quadrature-aware boundary-to-field model for resonant acoustics.
nodes.limits: Very close architectural prior art for coordinate-aware weighted integration. It does not establish optimal sparse-node selection, and known linear superposition is specific to the modeled setting.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: LatentDDM composition
nodes.title: Learnable composition for neural operators
nodes.summary: Pretrains local operators and adapts a lightweight composition module to changed domains or conditions.
nodes.limits: September 2026 preprint showing interest in modular transfer. Treat results as early evidence from selected benchmarks, not a settled foundation-model recipe.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Manifold-adaptive cubature
nodes.title: Dimensional hyperreduction of nonlinear finite element models via empirical cubature with manifold-adaptive weights
nodes.summary: Lets cubature weights vary with latent state and prunes integration entities in reduced finite-element models.
nodes.limits: September 2026 preprint especially close to the proposed adaptive-inference idea. Reported point reductions are benchmark-specific and are not neural-operator runtime measurements.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Principled architectures
nodes.title: Principled approaches for extending neural architectures to function spaces for operator learning
nodes.summary: Explains how to convert finite-dimensional network designs into function-space operators, with coordinates, quadrature and discretization convergence made explicit.
nodes.limits: Seed paper published July 2026. Provides the architectural framing for this review; only a short time has elapsed since publication, so most recent papers are contemporaneous work rather than verified descendants.
nodes.publication_status: Nature Machine Intelligence 8, 1173–1181 (2026); DOI 10.1038/s42256-026-01267-z

nodes.label: Multiscale frame kernels
nodes.title: The Frame Kernel Method for Multiscale Operator Learning
nodes.summary: Uses multiscale kernel-frame representations of input and output functions for operator learning.
nodes.limits: Late-August 2026 preprint offering a structured coefficient-space alternative to standard neural operators. A potentially useful comparator for sparse-basis ideas, but multiscale frames do not automatically imply sparse recoverability or cheap sensor acquisition.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv version collected; separate publication status not independently verified

nodes.label: Multiwavelet operator
nodes.title: Multiwavelet-based Operator Learning for Differential Equations
nodes.summary: Projects operator kernels onto fixed multiwavelet polynomial bases and learns interactions across scales. Demonstrated on several PDE families.
nodes.limits: Kernel compression here is a multiscale representation, not a compressed-sensing recovery guarantee. The abstract does not establish embedded vibration-monitoring latency.
nodes.publication_status: Primary arXiv record; year denotes first preprint

nodes.label: Wavelet Neural Operator
nodes.title: Wavelet neural operator: a neural operator for parametric partial differential equations
nodes.summary: Combines learned integral-kernel operations with localized wavelet transforms. Examples include PDE solution maps and air-temperature prediction.
nodes.limits: Spatial/frequency localization motivates studying transient signals, but this paper is not evidence of millisecond fault detection inside an IMU. Validate sampling, window length, memory and end-to-end delay separately.
nodes.publication_status: Primary arXiv record; year denotes first preprint

nodes.label: Operator learning complexity
nodes.title: The Parametric Complexity of Operator Learning
nodes.summary: Proves a curse of parametric complexity for general regular operator classes, and shows how Hamilton–Jacobi structure permits a more efficient architecture.
nodes.limits: Addresses whether operator models can be smaller: no universal compression law follows from using an operator architecture. Efficiency depends on structure in the target operator. These are approximation-complexity results, not empirical training scaling laws.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv preprint; year denotes first posting

nodes.label: Representation equivalent operators
nodes.title: Representation Equivalent Neural Operators: a Framework for Alias-free Operator Learning
nodes.summary: Introduces representation equivalence and operator aliasing to analyze consistency between continuous operators and their discrete implementations.
nodes.limits: Explains why shared weights across grids do not alone guarantee the same field-level computation. Varying training grids can encourage robustness, but cannot by itself guarantee alias-free evaluation or recover unmeasured information.
nodes.publication_status: arXiv preprint; year denotes first posting

nodes.label: Fast Gaussian quadrature
nodes.title: Fast and Accurate Computation of Gauss–Legendre and Gauss–Jacobi Quadrature Nodes and Weights
nodes.summary: Constructs Gauss–Legendre and Gauss–Jacobi nodes and weights efficiently using asymptotic formulas and Newton iteration.
nodes.limits: Background for the Gaussian quadrature article. Fast construction of a rule is distinct from integration error and neural-operator training cost; no benchmark was reproduced.
nodes.publication_status: SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 35(2), A652–A674 (2013)
